_comment: C1.3 audit finding #8 — the ONE authoritative classification of every database table's launch scope. scripts/schema-scope.test.mjs fails if any table declared in schema.sql or a migration is absent here, so this cannot silently drift as the schema grows. See docs/SCHEMA-SCOPE.md.

scopes.active: Used by a launched feature (a browser surface, or a documented server/POS surface).
scopes.backend_only: Written/read ONLY by trusted server code (Edge Functions / service role). No browser role reads it directly.
scopes.reserved: Schema exists for a future / not-yet-demonstrated domain. Not wired to any launch surface; browser roles must not depend on it.
scopes.deprecated: Superseded by another table; retained only for back-compat / migration.

cms_pages.note: Legacy CMS; superseded by site_content. Still anon-readable for back-compat; migrated by Legacy Import.

tax_codes.note: WS6d controlled VAT classification registry (4 statutory codes). Authenticated read-only; service-maintained; anon revoked.

media_assets.note: Media library rows; UPLOAD gated by VITE_MEDIA_V2.

staff_document_tombstones.note: T13.3.19 immutable deletion evidence and reconciliation tombstones; service-role written and browser-dark.

orders.note: WEB backup till orders (Web Till Orders screen).

pos_orders.note: NATIVE tablet till orders (Native Till Ledger).

pos_events.note: Native till sync events / outbox envelopes.

pos_catalog.note: Reverse catalogue sync to the till (pos-catalog function).

app_state.note: Generic server-held app persistence; not a browser surface.

activity_log.note: Append-only privileged-action audit; written only via service role.

anonymous_rate_buckets.note: T13.3.19 bounded atomic rate counters for anonymous and sensitive operations; server-only with scheduled retention.

storage_cleanup_jobs.note: Confirmed-delete job queue (media + CV objects). WS9: claim re-checks job_applications.cv_path — a referenced CV closes as status=reconciled, never deleted.

retention_runs.note: WS9 retention log: one row per sweep per entity (cutoff, rows deleted, jobs enqueued). Written only by the SECURITY DEFINER retention functions; RLS on, zero policies, API-role grants revoked.

customers.note: Future customer/CRM domain — not wired to any launch surface.

loyalty_transactions.note: Future loyalty domain — not wired to any launch surface.

ingredients.note: Future inventory domain — not wired to any launch surface.

stock_movements.note: Future inventory domain — not wired to any launch surface.

order_quotes.note: WS7 immutable priced snapshot: the proposed transaction before any money moves. Finalisation copies from it and never reprices. RPC-written; authenticated read is store-scoped.

quote_payment_attempts.note: WS7 payment-attempt ledger: one immutable-identity row per attempt, resolving once to DECLINED, ABANDONED or CONSUMED. Reservation ids are never recycled.

web_till_sessions.note: WS7 cash custody anchor for the browser till (open/closed drawer, opening float). No editable balance is stored; expected cash derives from financial events.

web_till_devices.note: WS7 registered browser-till installations, so a cash sale names the physical till that took the money.

payment_terminals.note: WS7 registered card terminals. Finalisation DERIVES the provider/merchant/terminal namespace from here; the client never supplies it.

online_payment_accounts.note: WS7b registered online (card-not-present) provider accounts. Finalisation DERIVES the online namespace from here; the client never supplies it. Admin-registered.

payment_reconciliations.note: WS7b append-only settlement evidence matching an operator-recorded card/online payment against an independent settlement source; the only path to PROVIDER_RECONCILED.

staff_compliance_records.note: R4.8 A1: authoritative compliance records; staff widget derives every label here.

admin_recovery_intents.note: R4.8 H2/H3: audited owner intents consumed by the employee-access-revoke function.

launch_settings.note: R4.8 F1: owner-managed mandatory launch facts; nothing seeded/invented.

privacy_notice_versions.note: R4.8 F4: versioned point-of-collection notices; submissions stamp the version.

notification_outbox.note: R4.8 C1: durable notification jobs; owner-readable, server-written only.

allergen_catalogue.note: R4.8 G1: 14 regulated categories as fixed reference codes.

ingredient_specifications.note: R4.8 G2: supplier spec revisions; owner-recorded evidence, never seeded.

menu_item_recipes.note: R4.8 G3: versioned BOM per sellable item.

product_allergen_declarations.note: R4.8 G3/G5: the only allergen truth customer surfaces may render; approval-gated.

ops_heartbeats.note: R4.8 M: scheduled-job liveness; absence renders unknown, never green.

ops_alert_state.note: T13.3.7: deduplicated owner alert state for worker failure, staleness and recovery.

payroll_export_batches.note: R4.8 O: approved-hours export boundary to the external payroll provider.

daily_closes.note: R4.8 O: append-only daily reconciliation; corrections reference originals.

collection_revisions.note: INC11: one monotonic revision per replaceable collection; authenticated read at hydration, written only by the SECURITY DEFINER bump trigger and the checkpoint helper. Closes same-count edit-edit loss in replace_collection.

staff_notice_acknowledgements.note: INC11: append-only record of which frozen staff-facing privacy notice each staff member acknowledged, and when. Self-insert via RLS; owner reads through the AAL2-aware helper; edits/deletes refused by trigger — acknowledgements are evidence.
